decisions.decision: Support negative forms of the selected spacing steps for margins and positioning offsets where CSS permits. Derive negatives from positive theme values; padding and gap remain nonnegative.
Width, height and their minimum/maximum limits accept the selected numeric theme steps plus valid CSS sizes. Numeric values identify theme steps, not pixels; step 8 defaults to 2rem.

Keep size and spacing tokens independently adjustable, with matching default numeric steps. Changing a spacing token need not change the corresponding dimension token; density remains a separate spacing-only policy to specify.

For overlapping style properties under the same responsive condition, follow Chakra's declaration-order behavior rather than a fixed all-sides/axis/side priority. This is declaration order, not automatically latest value-update order. Define the cross-HTML/Lit/React contract explicitly.
